llama_cpp_source_audit.finding: The model graph folds the six/nine GQA queries into the row dimension before final tuning, so Laguna decode selects AMD subgroup64 cooperative-matrix Br16 x Bc64/local256 rather than the scalar n_rows==1 fallback. The transferable mechanism is grouped K/V tile reuse and compact online state; its low-precision cooperative arithmetic does not preserve Laguna's exact scalar F32 QK/PV association.

interpretation.result: DPP QK transfers exactly as measured: SWA falls 6.06% and complete attention falls 4.37%, accounting for nearly all of the 0.107 ms/token kernel-sum reduction.
interpretation.next: Attention remains the largest named Vulkan gap, but exact scalar topology-only copies of the comparator are exhausted. Screen metadata-free full-ring SWA decode under an explicit no-eviction qualification before opening another changed-arithmetic cooperative core.
